name: Rotten Arakkoa egg
shortDescription: The egg Borak sends the adventurer to trade for bloodthistle in Shattrath.
body: The egg Borak sends the adventurer to trade for bloodthistle in Shattrath. Visual details are original generated research art, not canonical model evidence. Composition, markings, costume and exact game resemblance await human comparison with the target Burning Crusade client.
